project_type: Electron Desktop Application - Offline Quran Progress Tracker
test_framework: Jest for unit tests, Spectron/Playwright for E2E (optional in v1)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install to install dependencies. 2. Run npm test to verify unit tests pass. 3. Run npm start to launch the Electron app and verify it opens without errors.
environment_constraints: Node.js v22.22.3, npm 11.4.2, x86_64 Linux. Full internet access available for npm packages. No display server available so Electron GUI cannot be visually tested but can be launched in headless/no-sandbox mode for validation.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - establish conventions from scratch
key_patterns: Electron main/renderer process split. Preload script for IPC bridge. better-sqlite3 for database. RTL Arabic-first UI. Status color system with labels and icons.
directory_structure: quran-tracker/ - main.js (Electron main process), preload.js (IPC bridge), src/renderer/ (HTML/CSS/JS frontend), src/db/ (SQLite schema and seeds), src/services/ (business logic), src/utils/ (helpers), src/data/ (static Quran data)
